mainText: Hello, Verona! At 9 PM, here is today's balanced dish: current temperatures are 61 degrees under overcast skies at Badger Prairie County Park. Under the waxing crescent moon, keep an eye out for the International Space Station at 10:01 PM, rising in the northwest near Verona High School and moving toward the northeast near Home Depot. The overnight low will be 61 degrees with rain in the forecast.
There are no important emails to report today, but the city continues to keep residents informed through regular police updates and community notices.

There is plenty to do in town, starting with Yoga at Insight Wellness today. Tomorrow, you can enjoy trivia at Hop Haus Brewing, Lake Lou-ee, or Paddy Mac's, plus live music at Paddy Mac's and the Farmer's Market in Hometown Junction Park.
On September 5, the Verona Police Department responded to a series of reports involving vehicles having cheese slices left on their windshields, a viral prank identified by the department.
The Culver's of Verona location is currently closed for a remodel, so enjoy your evening and check back soon for updates on when they will be back to serving their signature flavors.
